original.title: Agent publishes Closeout videos and screenshots and Linear gets a Paws link (PAS-354)
original.head: d342fdd13912d6a81a3ab9d213109579af4f7890

fix.title: fix: give Closeout evidence activities a UUID v4 id and repair stuck sessions (PAS-378)

bug: The Closeout evidence activity reused the evidence ULID as its Linear activity id, which Linear rejects because it is not a UUID, so the outbox row went dead and blocked later activities in that session.

original.title: Closeout requires visual proof when a change touches frontend files (PAS-393)
original.head: 01359d25a39bbbb70899abc42a4d3e03f0eff47e

fix.title: fix(closeout-spec): count visual proof published before a rebase

bug: Visual proof counted only when published at the head or one of its ancestors, so a rebase dropped all proof and the re-check looped on visual-proof until Closeout rejected the candidate.

original.title: Make the timing-sensitive tests pass under parallel load, and run CI and Closeout tests in parallel again (PAS-437)
original.head: fb870b7e9c48861f7928be1a52c49a0b836868e6

fix.title: Make the flaky CI tests deterministic under parallel load (PAS-471)

bug: CI switched to `bun test --parallel=4` without the `--timeout=20000` that the package test script uses, so slow tests hit bun's 5 s default under parallel load and CI flaked.

original.title: Register agent skills in Paws, pinned to an exact version (PAS-447)
original.head: c025e57bb6610ce9e8a33c0a0303e8da7462a3ce

fix.title: Count only the subfolder of a git skill toward the bundle limit (PAS-516)

bug: The git skill resolver counted the whole repository checkout against the 50 MB bundle limit before narrowing to the skill's subfolder, so a small skill in a large repository was rejected as too large.

original.title: Stop every agent process when a run ends, including detached sandboxes (PAS-446)
original.head: fcf21660e0006f000063dbeafd9a68c66bc93c91

fix.title: Rename the runner's execution tag so Paws stops reading it as its mode (PAS-518)

bug: The runner's per-execution tag reused PAWS_EXECUTION, the variable Paws already reads as its execution mode, so a Paws started inside a runner job (such as Closeout's bun test) threw "PAWS_EXECUTION must be remote".

original.title: Runners install the registered skills into the agent home (PAS-448)
original.head: c3768282172bc53875016a3734d979009e3efc67

fix.title: Keep skill scripts executable when a runner installs them (PAS-599)

bug: The runner unpacked every skill bundle file as 0600 and copied it into the agent home as 0644, so skill scripts lost their executable bit and skill hooks failed with Permission denied.

original.title: Update a runner's coding agents from the Runners page (PAS-620)
original.head: 0d5708c44599c1f3ae6eab0e2648ce8e7a869cd5

bug: The native-version check collected every lockfile version of the native package, so codex's npm-alias platform builds made the list differ from the expected version and every codex update was refused.

original.title: Create VM joins the Paws tailnet when Paws is only reachable on Tailscale (PAS-656)
original.head: 1ad3437205ad2fb0ec7032a9bf1932da2760f37e

fix.title: Create VM starts tailscaled before joining the tailnet, also when Tailscale is already installed (PAS-686)

bug: joinTailnet ran `tailscale up` without making sure tailscaled was running, so when the installed Tailscale version already matched and the install step was skipped, the join failed against a stopped daemon.

original.title: PAS-723: Keep every run on its assigned runner
original.head: 8f5040d7ff04854eca1a906fec1e3cb7ef726f22

fix.title: fix: prepare reviewers after runner moves or ejection

bug: The run's runner pin also applied to prepare-only reviewer placements, so after a run moved or its runner was ejected, reviewer preparation stayed tied to the old pinned host.

original.title: Remove retired configuration shims and refresh agent guidance
original.head: d943204102a09c7628f83fc3ce4a67047809710e

bug: The new unknown-section check rejected the retired [update] section that existing config.toml files still contained, so Paws refused to start on those configs.

original.title: PAS-627: unify restart() and ask() around one run and session
original.head: a5d1b6922e76a4eff0627aee5f89f1e777a28afa

fix.title: Bound fix rounds and prevent rebase budget refills

bug: The fix-round progress counter counted every restart the item ever had while the budget counted only rounds since the last answer, so after a person's reply the session showed impossible counts such as "fix attempt 5 of 3".

original.title: Keep post-PR sessions quiet until their final response
original.head: 91fbcd4b5c1c64dd72275538cb778e2190c6b23b

fix.title: PAS-689: Blocked and queued items say what they wait for and never go stale

bug: The restart progress step was keyed by item.version, which changes with every new run in the same fix round, so a run restarted after an answer, recovery or runner move appended a duplicate fix step to the plan.

original.title: Pause the task and ask for a visual review in Linear (PAS-442)
original.head: 5cccbd52879434ea52112b471bd52e0ea94d0d09

fix.title: Ask for the visual review last, with every screenshot (PAS-553)

bug: The visual review question opened mid-turn as soon as one publish met the minimum, so later screenshots and the 24 hour reminder posted after it and Linear stopped showing its Accept and Request changes buttons.

original.title: PAS-727: Restore the Claude session when a run moves to another runner
original.head: de60c2e6965929b3c3e2f3f444a8b012f04140c9

bug: The test fixture heartbeated both runners at the same clock value, so placement's tie-break fell to same-millisecond ULIDs and the tests that expect runner A first failed about half the time.
note: A test-fixture escape. The script cannot find it: the fix only adds a line, so blame has nothing to point at.

original.title: Admit delegations through a durable intake queue, a few at a time (PAS-459)
original.head: 4c6d92e457e4acc1a0f8fe3aa8aeb7a4458e0d78

fix.title: fix: retry Linear and GitHub 5xx and rate limits consistently

bug: The intake failure handler excluded only Linear rate limits from the error activity, so a transient Linear 5xx posted a terminal "could not start work" error even though the intake queue retries it.

original.title: Closeout says when it waits for a paused or offline runner (PAS-445)
original.head: 6b629b149c2c5848661ee853544e5887f0a0f581

fix.title: Questions own the ask and answer lifecycle, with runner wait as the first kind (PAS-560)

bug: The runner-wait answer reached Closeout only through an in-memory waiter, so an answer that arrived after a Paws restart and before Closeout asked again went down the agent path and was rejected.
